label: Week of 6 September
notes: Saturday's Drive run already brought the proteins and the starch — aiguillettes de poulet, viande hachée, côtes de porc, chipolatas, riz basmati, deux pâtes à pizza, pesto, mozzarella, gouda, cheddar. The week is built around them.
The vegetables failed to go through on the Intermarché site, so this order is almost entirely produce. That is the gap, not a new week's shop.

The basket below is derived from the full recipes, so it re-lists the meat, rice and dough already sitting in the kitchen. Ignore those lines — the outstanding spend is about 72 €, not the total shown.
Chinese, Thai and French vegetable-forward, as asked. No chilli anywhere: no piment, harissa, gochujang or sauce piquante.
